newsitem.title: USA: Eaton gets 95.6pct of Fusion shrs in tender.
newsitem.headline: Eaton gets 95.6pct of Fusion shrs in tender.

text.p: Eaton Corp said Monday its subsidiary ETN Acquisition Corp received received about 95.6 percent of the outstanding shares of Fusion Systems Corp in its $39-a-share tender offer.
Eaton, which announced on June 30 it would buy Fusion, said shareholders had tendered 7.2 million shares when its tender offer expired at 2400 EDT/0400 GMT August 1.
The diversified engineering firm said ETN Acquisition will merge into Fusion, a supplier of front-end process equipment to the semiconductor industry, following the tender.
Fusion shareholders who did not tender their shares will receive $39 in cash.
Fusion's stock closed at 38-7/8 Friday, while Eaton traded at 88-1/16 Monday morning, up 3/8.
